recipes.title: Carnivore Glazed Donuts (Honey Cream Cheese Glaze)

items.i: milk powder or heavy cream powder
cream cheese (raw if you can get it), softened

steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk in the milk powder (or cream powder), baking powder and melted butter until smooth.
Pour into a greased donut tray.
Bake about 10 minutes (around 350°F) until puffed and golden.
While they bake, mix the raw honey and cream cheese until smooth.
Dip the warm donuts in the glaze.
recipes.notes: The caption only says to comment for the recipe, so this is put together from what he says and shows in the video: 4 eggs, milk or cream powder, baking powder and butter, baked about 10 minutes, then dipped in a raw honey and cream cheese glaze. The amounts, oven temperature, number of donuts and macros are my estimates.
